resources.string: This did not reach the server or needs a look. Nothing is deleted on its own: you decide. Retry sends it again; Discard removes it from this phone and records who did it.
All up to date: nothing to review.
This ticket was already charged or discarded on another phone. It was saved as a separate sale so no money is lost: check in Sales whether it is a duplicate.
This ticket was already charged or discarded on another phone: check before discarding.
Goes over the credit limit of %1$s: limit %2$s, already owed %3$s. Raise the limit or collect part of it, then retry.
Goes over the customer\'s credit limit. Raise the limit or collect part of it, then retry.
That credit was already closed (written off or cancelled on another phone) and the customer has no other debts: the payment was not saved. Give the money back or record it another way.
The customer no longer owed anything: the payment was not saved. Give the money back or record it another way.
The person who did it was disabled before it was sent.
The person who did it must confirm their PIN on this phone (online). Tap “Confirm PIN” and it is sent again.
The person who did it is not allowed to do this.
The payments do not add up to the sale total.
The business requires a listed customer on every credit.
The credit already has payments: void them first.
What was being changed no longer exists on the server.
Another product already uses that code.
“%1$s” leaves the list and this phone stops counting it. Who discarded it and when is recorded. If it was money received, record it another way so the till balances.
“%1$s” is already saved on the server: it is only removed from this list.
The owner of %1$s disabled your access. This phone can no longer sell or see the business data.
The business owner disabled your access. This phone can no longer sell or see the business data.
Everything you did before being disabled has been sent.

plurals.name: disabled_pending
plurals.item: %d operation is still unsent. Keep the phone online so it reaches the business.
%d operations are still unsent. Keep the phone online so they reach the business.

plurals.name: disabled_failed
plurals.item: %d operation was not accepted because it was done after you were disabled.
%d operations were not accepted because they were done after you were disabled.

resources.string: What you charged before being disabled does reach the business. If you think this is a mistake, talk to the owner.

plurals.name: disabled_exit_body
plurals.item: If you leave now, %d unsent operation is deleted from this phone and never reaches the business.
If you leave now, %d unsent operations are deleted from this phone and never reach the business.

resources.string: %1$s was disabled and can no longer sign in on this phone. What they did before being disabled is still sent.
There are unsent operations from %2$s (%1$d). Sign back in to that business with internet to send them before switching.
There are unsent operations from the previous business (%1$d). Sign back in to that business with internet to send them before switching.
“%1$s” for %2$s is removed from parked tickets on every phone. Nothing was charged.
It could no longer be undone: the 5 minutes had passed or it was not your last sale. The sale is still paid; ask the owner or an admin to delete it.
The return was not applied: more than what was left was returned, the credit no longer covered it, or it was not allowed.
It was made by someone who was deactivated and it is not credible that it happened before (too old, before the phone was linked, or everything had already been sent).
